what: Raw readings taken 2026-09-21 on ko-KR Logic Pro 12.3 (6674): whether a menu leaf under Mix > 트랙 오토메이션 생성 creates an automation point, and whether a created point can then be read
how: Every line below is a string read back from Logic, not a description of one. The menu rows were read with the menu OPEN so the enabled flags are freshly validated; the undo labels were read from the first item of the 편집 menu; the element census was taken by walking the arrange window from its root to depth 14.
